groups.title: A　間接疑問句與名詞子句

items.note: 塞進句子不倒裝：主詞 + will。

items.q: I'm not sure ______ he's coming to the meeting.
Could you tell me how much ______?
items.note: do 消失，動詞保留 s。

items.q: The problem is ______ we have no stock.

items.note: 介係詞後面接間接疑問句，不用 do。

items.q: "We will ship on Monday." → They said they ______ on Monday.
"Can you reduce the price?" → He asked ______ reduce the price.
items.note: 問句轉述 → if，不倒裝，can → could。

items.q: "Please send the drawing." → He asked us ______ the drawing.
items.note: 命令轉述 = ask + 人 + to V。

items.q: He ______ that the test had failed.
"I am busy." → She said she ______ busy.
可以告訴我零件什麼時候會到嗎？
items.a: Could you tell me when the parts will arrive?

items.q: 我不知道我們能不能提早出貨，我查一下。
items.a: I'm not sure if we can ship early. Let me check.

items.q: 客戶說他們星期五前要拿到。
items.a: The customer said (that) they needed it by Friday. / …they need it by Friday.
items.note: 正式退一格 needed；口語 need 也可以。

items.a: He asked if we could lower the price.
The problem is that we have no stock.
items.note: The problem is that… 固定開頭。
